top_stories.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
top_stories.description: For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.
